scaffoldNote: PLACEHOLDER — this is the scaffold's style lock, not your game's. game-art Step 1 replaces it: write this game's own artStyle/palette/lighting/outline, set a new kebab `name`, list the Step 1b vision anchors in `references`, and DELETE the `scaffold` and `scaffoldNote` keys. scripts/release-check.mjs fails while they are here, because a game generated against this file is a game with no art direction of its own. The prose below is a real, working vibrant-chibi profile (the template's own art was generated from it) — keep it only if this game genuinely IS vibrant chibi, and even then re-name it and add your anchors.
name: scaffold-placeholder-vibrant-chibi
artStyle: Vibrant 2D chibi game art: two-heads-tall proportions, oversized round head, huge expressive eyes with a single bright specular dot, tiny stubby limbs, no visible neck. Clean vector-like cel shading with exactly two shadow steps and one hard highlight, thick dark navy outline of even weight around every silhouette, and a soft inner rim light on the upper-left. Saturated candy colours on near-black backgrounds, glossy plastic-toy finish, chunky readable shapes with no fine linework or texture noise. Consistent 3/4 front-facing camera, no perspective distortion, no photographic detail, no gradients larger than a single body part.
camera: Straight-on 3/4 front view, subject centred, constant camera distance and constant standing-equivalent scale across every frame and every asset in the set.
lighting: Single cool key light from the upper left, one warm bounce fill from the lower right, one hard specular dot per glossy surface, ambient occlusion only where two shapes meet. No cast shadow, no ground contact shading, no ground plane.
outline: Uniform 3px dark navy (#05070d) outline on the outer silhouette, thinner internal separation lines only between overlapping body parts. Never a light or coloured outline.

plan.temperature: Cool cyan-to-navy for allies, armour, glass and UI chrome; warm magenta-through-red for every threat; gold reserved for rewards and progression. Warm and cool never share the same value tier, so a threat always reads against an ally at thumbnail size.

focal.primary: the face and eyes of the character, or the single icon glyph on a UI element
focal.secondary: the silhouette-defining prop: weapon, horn, crown, spike, gem
focal.rest: large unbroken areas of mid-value navy body mass and flat UI fill

materials.skin: matte soft-toy vinyl, no pores, no subsurface detail, warm mid value
materials.metal: polished chrome with one sharp specular streak and a dark reflected core
materials.cloth: thick felt with rounded folds, only two value steps, never woven texture
materials.energy: glowing translucent gel with a bright core and a soft additive fringe
materials.chitin: hard glossy shell with a single wide highlight band, faceted not organic
materials.glass: clear panel with a diagonal highlight streak and darker rim
materials.wood: smooth painted toy wood, chunky bevel, no grain lines
